legend.0: Trivial: copy, styling or configuration with no behavioral impact.
legend.1: Low: a localized behavior change in one module, easy to verify and revert.
legend.2: Medium: a behavior change across several modules, or one that touches persisted data.
legend.3: High: changes a critical flow (payments, authentication, orders) or data shared by many features.
legend.4: Critical: could cause data loss, a security exposure or a full outage if wrong.
